Title: Hokkaido Winter 2-Day Tour: Icebreaker Cruise, Sounkyo & Zoo
Description:
Exclusive Winter Experience – Explore Hokkaido’s snowy landscapes, ice festivals, and frozen waterfalls.

Snow Adventures for All Ages – Enjoy Snow Tubing, Snow Soccer, Fat Bikes, and Bubble Balls at Asahiyama Snow Park.

Wildlife Encounters – Watch the famous Penguin Walk and other active animal displays at Asahiyama Zoo.

Spectacular Waterfalls – Marvel at Ryusei (“Shooting Star”) and Ginga (“Milky Way”) Waterfalls in Sounkyo Gorge.

Icebreaker Cruise on the Sea of Okhotsk – Break through drift ice aboard Garinko III and spot seals and polar wildlife.

Local Cuisine & Crab Culture – Savor fresh Hokkaido seafood in Monbetsu, including photo ops at the Giant Crab Claw.

Relaxing Hot Springs & Icefall Festival – Unwind at a Sounkyo Onsen hotel and enjoy dazzling ice sculptures and illuminations.

Perfect for Families, Couples, or Groups – Combines adventure, nature, wildlife, and cultural experiences in one convenient 2-day trip.

Title: Scenic Autumn Day Trip from Sapporo Hoheikyo Gorge & Buffet Lunch
Description:
Experience the enchanting autumnal hues on a day trip from Sapporo. Indulge in a lavish buffet lunch at Jozankei Tsuruga Resort, where you can relish gourmet delicacies amidst tranquil surroundings.

Next, venture to Hoheikyo Gorge, where the grandeur of nature unfolds before your eyes. Take leisurely strolls along the gorge's trails, marveling at the breathtaking vistas of cascading waterfalls and vibrant foliage. Continue your adventure at Takino Suzuran Hillside Park, where you'll be captivated by the charming crimson pampas grass, evoking a whimsical atmosphere reminiscent of a fairy tale.

Wrap up your day with a shopping spree at Mitsui Outlet Park, offering over 170 stores with a wide array of products at discounted prices. From the serenity of nature to the thrill of shopping, this day trip promises an unforgettable experience that caters to all your senses.

Title: Private Hakodate Night Illumination Tour
Description:
Experience the magic of Hakodate as the city lights up after dark on this enchanting night tour. Begin with breathtaking views from Mount Hakodate, where the city sparkles like a sea of jewels—truly one of the world's most beautiful nightscapes.

Next, explore Hakodate’s historical landmarks under illumination. Stroll along Hachiman-zaka Slope, famous from films, TV dramas, and commercials, offering a stunning waterfront view. Visit the Old Public Hall of Hakodate Ward, a 1910 wooden Western-style building designated as an Important Cultural Property of Japan. The Kanemori Red Brick Warehouses have been transformed into beer halls, restaurants, and shops, blending history with modern charm.

The tour also highlights Hakodate’s iconic churches: the Harisutosu Orthodox Church, Japan’s oldest Greek Orthodox Church built in 1859; the Motomachi Catholic Church, featuring a Gothic-style altar gifted by the Pope; and St. John’s Church, a modern design by British Protestant missionaries.

Title: Sapporo Day Trip: Market, Okurayama, Shiroi Koibito & Otaru Canal
Description: Explore Sapporo and Otaru in one well-paced day. After hotel pickup, head to Sapporo’s Jogai Market to browse fresh seafood and local produce, sample Hokkaido favorites, and hunt for unique local treats. Then visit the legendary Okurayama Ski Jump Stadium (Okurayama Schanze): ride the ropeway for panoramic city views and step into the on-site museum to learn its history and the excitement of ski jumping. Continue to Shiroi Koibito Park to watch chocolate being made and enjoy the photogenic grounds and clock-tower show. After a short highway drive, arrive in Otaru—stroll the canal lined with stone warehouses and gas lamps, enjoy free time for lunch, explore Sakaimachi Street’s glass and music-box boutiques, and, time permitting, join a brief canal cruise. Relax on the ride back to your Sapporo hotel—a seamless day of culture, cuisine, and classic Hokkaido scenery. Includes: Okurayama Ropeway & Museum; Shiroi Koibito Park admission; hotel pickup and drop-off.
